scope: Eight Android and related cross-platform open-source readers. This inventory indexes the dated evidence in knowledge/alternatives-android.md; the 21 draft proposals are in data/alternative-proposals-android.json.
limitations: Source and documentation inspection only: no application build, runtime, performance, accessibility or synchronization test was executed.
Formats and platforms are documented or statically advertised capabilities, not rendering-conformance or released-artifact guarantees. Per-app qualifications apply.
Six applications received targeted implementation review; Orion and Anx received documentation, license and build-configuration review only.
Issue searches were bounded first-page searches; open issues do not prove continuing defects and closed issues do not prove working fixes.
Observation date records retrieval, not release date. Exact inspected ranges, version/activity evidence and all citations remain in the report.

E-ink-oriented UI, contrast and fit zoom
StarDict dictionary and Wikipedia lookup
Calibre metadata, wireless receipt and OPDS catalogs
Wallabag integration and RSS feeds
Reader modules for highlights, bookmarks, TOC and full-text search
Current-book, selected-file and history-wide annotation exports
Multiple export targets and highlight style/color filters
Plugin extensibility

Concrete format/MIME registration seam; CBR aliases differ from the values requested in issue #15844.

Exporter settings, identity, readiness and export contract.
L77-104 registers targets; L181-206 supplies export scopes; L343-394 includes style and color filters.

Selected provider, reader-module, and export code was inspected; no runtime or rendering-conformance test was run.

Issue searches were first-page bounded; release parity and APK/source reproducibility were not checked.

L31-180 integrates WebView layout and read-ahead; L378-453 and L482-503 implement CFI/text anchors with nonblocking main-thread misses.

L9-12 names 10.1.14; L121-187 and L300-327 define Pro/F-Droid/JS variants; L399-403 declares PDFium.

limitations: Selected code paths only; main-thread misses do not establish loss of anchors across every caller. No profiling or cross-flavor runtime tests were run.
Selected codec, foliate/WebView, CSS, and build paths were inspected; no application runtime was tested.
F-Droid, Pro, and MuPDF-free JS variants must not be assumed to have identical capabilities.
The frozen-development README notice coexists with observed 2026-11-21 commits; maintenance guarantees were not established.
LibreraX is a separate product; dependency-level license and released-build parity were not fully audited.

L23-68 declares Room version 15, PDF records, save destinations, scan entries, bookmarks and migrations.
L16-167 wraps page text/metrics/thumbnail/link/note access and closes page handles; metrics have a 20000-character cap.
L29-168 exposes extraction ownership, jobs, caching, nearby prefetch and out-of-window cancellation.
L15-78 maps folded-text match ranges back to original character indices.
L13-68 centralizes filters and formatted annotation export with TOC/color/date callbacks.
L65-69 and L277-316 implement SAF plain-text highlight export.
L57-61 and L223-261 implement SAF plain-text note export.

limitations: App-layer wrappers and selected XML were read, not all viewer/JNI internals. No annotation-save, rendering, TTS or large-font scenario was executed.
GitLab is canonical; the GitHub issue-facing mirror is older and differs from the inspected source.
Selected extraction, text-mode, Room, export, and layout code was inspected; no runtime was tested.

Roadmap entries are proposals, not confirmed shipped capabilities; build-file version is not a verified store release.

alternatives.name: MuPDF Android Viewer

features.name: System Storage Access Framework document picker
Open With and ACTION_VIEW integration
Fitz rendering and reflowable document layout
Password prompt and authentication
Previous and next text-search navigation
Bounded outline navigation
Page slider/readout and saved reading position
Pinch zoom, fling/scroll and edge-tap navigation
Font-size relayout preserving a document bookmark
Link dispatch and navigation-history code paths

observations: SAF chooser dispatches ACTION_VIEW with separate-document/task flags.
Selected L48-227 ranges own document/page/display-list rendering, zero-based page access, relayout bookmarks, search, links and bounded outlines.
Selected intent/password/search/layout/slider/persistence ranges are itemized in the report; UI adds one to internal page indices.
L120-132 manages history; L473 has empty long press; L917-928 follows an internal link only when its returned page is greater than zero.
Internal links return resolved page index; external/no-link outcomes also return zero, creating the page-zero reproduction candidate.
VIEW/BROWSABLE MIME registrations advertise supported document types.
Library 1.28.5a, fitz 1.28.5, minSdk 21 and local-or-Maven JNI dependency.

limitations: No native fitz implementation review or on-device reproduction; the simplified viewer scope differs from the full MuPDF editor.
This simplified viewer explicitly excludes annotation editing and form filling; full MuPDF product capabilities do not transfer to it.
Selected chooser, activity, core, page, and gesture code was inspected; no runtime was tested.
The page-zero link finding is a source-level reproduction candidate, not a confirmed on-device defect.
MIME handlers establish advertised formats, not complete rendering conformance or released-build parity.
